name: aot-evals
description: Part of AOT, the Agent Optimization Toolkit, a Mahal Systems offering. Build and iterate the evals for a production agent, each written down as an estimator with four parts (the estimand, the sampling design, the measurement model and the decision rule), in three phases: Assess (a discovery report: what the agent is for and where its evals go), Build (the agent wired up, a quality set drawn from real traffic, a check per failure mode, the decision rule, a baseline) and Judge (a local grader application where the people who know what good looks like label runs and the evals are held to them). A stdlib CLI records every attempt, and a fixed report.json schema renders into a local HTML diagnostic.
